metadata.provenance: Bundled HYG/SJB analytical return series. Original provider response, adjustment verification and retrieval time were not recorded; cache identity alone does not verify historical accuracy.
metadata.adjustment: auto_adjust=False; analytical inputs use Adj Close for both funds. Raw closes are retained for inspection.
metadata.cash_provenance: UNVERIFIED legacy rf_annual_pct; original source, quote basis and timing unavailable. Interpreted only as an assumed effective annual rate, prior observation, actual/365.

notes: OLS of SJB daily excess returns on HYG daily excess returns over the full cache; cash is subtracted from both series.
UNVERIFIED cash assumption: legacy rf_annual_pct is interpreted as an effective annual percentage, using the previous observation and actual/365. Original provider and quote basis are unknown.
HYG is a comparison proxy, not an identical benchmark. A beta near -1 indicates inverse co-movement, not proof of exact target delivery.
The intercept combines benchmark differences, tracking, expenses, and noise; it is not an exact expense estimate.

rolling_notes: Each window uses 63 return intervals and 64 prices. Research returns are compounded asset total return minus separately compounded cash return.
Research volatility is zero-mean root-sum-squared daily HYG excess returns, annualized by sqrt(252/N); sample volatility is separate.
Windows overlap and are not independent observations.
The y=-x line is the funded no-rebalance -1x excess-return benchmark before costs. HYG is a tradable proxy, not the exact index; tracking and expenses also affect the gap.
UNVERIFIED cash assumption: legacy rf_annual_pct is interpreted as an effective annual percentage, using the previous observation and actual/365. Original provider and quote basis are unknown.

scenarios.name: 2020 stress
scenarios.rule: February through June 2020: selloff and initial recovery; dates resolved inward to shared observations.

scenarios.name: 2022 drawdown
scenarios.rule: Calendar 2022; dates resolved inward to shared observations.

scenarios.name: Choppy period
scenarios.rule: Highest HYG realized volatility among 126-interval windows with absolute net HYG return <= 2%, excluding overlaps with stress presets. Earliest window wins ties; selected in-sample.

scenarios.name: Full history
scenarios.rule: All shared observations in the loaded cache.

static_short.objective: Maximize the worst ending portfolio return across overlapping rolling windows.

assumptions.label: Proxy
assumptions.detail: The restricted book follows adjusted HYG returns, not individual bond exposures.

assumptions.label: Capital accounting
assumptions.detail: Equal initial equity. SJB borrowing compounds at cash plus the funding spread; short collateral compounds at cash minus the rebate spread. Spreads are continuous annual decimal spreads, and borrow fees are separate.

assumptions.label: Cash input
assumptions.detail: UNVERIFIED cash assumption: legacy rf_annual_pct is interpreted as an effective annual percentage, using the previous observation and actual/365. Original provider and quote basis are unknown.

assumptions.label: Static short
assumptions.detail: Negative adjusted HYG return on initial hedge exposure, less 2.00% annual borrow cost using actual elapsed calendar days / 365. This is a return-series approximation, not an executable short ledger.

assumptions.label: SJB hedge
assumptions.detail: Buy and hold the initial SJB investment. Observed adjusted returns include distributions and fund expenses; no additional expense deduction is applied.

assumptions.label: User assumptions
assumptions.detail: Funding spread 0.00%; rebate spread 0.00%; round-trip hedge cost 0 bp on initial notional, charged once after inception. Zero costs are assumptions, not observed execution.

assumptions.label: Proxy stress
assumptions.detail: Book beta 1; annual additive basis return 0.00%. These are sensitivities, not holdings-based DV01/CS01 or default models.

assumptions.label: Capacity
assumptions.detail: User-supplied maximum initial hedge notional: None. Without a supplied limit, market capacity is unverified; no ADV or market-impact estimate is implied.

assumptions.label: Termination
assumptions.detail: Research paths freeze at first equity-floor breach (0% of initial equity), retaining overshoot. This is a stress cutoff, not broker margin or executable liquidation of a restricted book. Recalls and intraday margin remain unmodeled.

assumptions.label: Exposure drift
assumptions.detail: Initial investments are held as return-series exposures. SJB resets internally but the investor does not rebalance; time-varying hedge/book ratios are reported. Adjusted returns assume distribution reinvestment, not fixed shares.

assumptions.label: Excluded costs
assumptions.detail: No observed quotes, market impact, short recalls, broker-specific margin schedules, or taxes. This is a research sensitivity, not an executable trade ledger.

assumptions.label: Historical selection
assumptions.detail: Selected and evaluated on the same overlapping history; no holdout. Each window starts with a fresh hedge. Capacity limits exclude infeasible grid ratios.

assumptions.label: Grid and tradeoffs
assumptions.detail: Ratios 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05; ties favor the smaller ratio. Worst ending return is not within-window drawdown.
